title: The Latest Crier for May 12, 2026

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Central Student Tradition – Breakfast of Champions SP26 – Monday, May 11, 9:30-10:30PM

The annual student tradition Breakfast of Champions is back Monday, May 11 from 9:30-10:30PM! Enjoy Breakfast favs–Fresh toppings bar–fresh local donuts–all beverage stations will be open! Celebrate the end of the semester with a late-night study break where staff and faculty serve up delicious food, encouragement, and fun!

Tutoring and Writing Hub

Tutoring for Finals Week: 
From Sunday, May 10 - Wednesday, May 13, the Tutoring and Writing Hub will be open for on-call appointments only. Please contact Denise Koolmees – koolmeesd@central.edu to set up an appointment.

Doing a World of Good: Log your Tulip Time volunteer hours

If you volunteered during Tulip Time, make sure you log your hours on Central's World of Good website: https://centralcollege.formstack.com/forms/service_hours. It only takes a minute and your hours help to show the economic impact volunteering has. 
Thanks for helping and making a difference!

Graduating Senior Gifts

Graduating class of 2026...Senior week is here! Be sure to pick up your senior gifts this week. Tuesday-Thursday, look for our table from 11 a.m. - 1 p.m. in Central Market, and Friday you will receive your last gift at graduation practice. Good luck on your finals!

The Final Spin- Lotus Bar and Giveaway Pop-Up

Its final week! We would love for you to stop by the Maytag Atruim, Tuesday May 12th, starting at 11:00 am, for a free Lotus drink and give the wheel a final spin for some fun giveaways.

Intro to Statistics (MATH 105) offered online this summer

In case you’re needing credits, an EXP3 course, or need MATH 105 for your major/minor, you’re in luck as MATH 105 is offered this summer! MATH 105: Intro to Statistics will be offered online this summer from 6/1-8/7 and will be a fully asynchronous course. There will be deadlines along the way, lots of virtual office hours, but also lots of flexibility in completing the course over the summer. Please note though, MATH 105 is a 4-credit course with a healthy workload. 
If you have questions or want more information, email goodmanr@central.edu .
